STEP 1 - Vessel type: flat plate (square/rounded-square white plate). The food sits on a flat surface with a visible rim band and no inner wall.

STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Type: the plate is rectangular-ish with rounded corners, roughly a standard dinner plate in size, so about 25-28 cm.
b) Reference: the broccoli florets are about 4 cm across. The plate spans roughly 6-7 florets across its width, giving about 24-28 cm.
Reconciled width: about 26 cm (square-ish plate, area roughly 26 x 26 = 676 cm²).

STEP 3 - Food items:
- Pizza slice (cheese, one wedge): a triangular slice roughly 11 cm long, about 1.5 cm thick, about 1/8 of a 26 cm pizza. Area about 60 cm² x 1.5 cm = 90 ml x 1.0 (cheese/bread mix, use ~0.8) = about 70 g. Note this is one slice, roughly 70-80 g.
- Chicken/meat pieces (upper right, cooked, looks like thigh or roast): footprint about 60 cm² (about 9% of plate), thickness about 2 cm average (one piece stacked about 2 deep at the thickest point, mound averages about half its peak, so about 1.5-2 cm). Volume about 100 ml x 1.0 = about 100 g.
- Broccoli florets (about 5-6 florets, moist, cooked): footprint about 90 cm² (about 13%), thickness about 2.5 cm (chunky pieces, mound). Volume about 225 ml x 0.6 = about 135 g.
- Mixed leafy salad (shredded greens with some pink onion or radicchio, dressed): footprint about 110 cm² (about 16%), thickness about 2 cm (loose leaves, partly compressed). Volume about 220 ml x 0.15 (raw leafy) = about 33 g. Dressing is light, so add about 5 g of oil/dressing.
- Hidden base: no clear base layer under the pizza or meat; the plate surface is visible, so no additional base is added.

Totals: pizza ~75 g, meat ~100 g, broccoli ~135 g, salad ~38 g. Total about 350 g.

STEP 5 - kcal per 100 g:
- Pizza (cheese slice): about 270 kcal/100 g
- Cooked meat (chicken/pork, roasted): about 200 kcal/100 g
- Broccoli, cooked: about 35 kcal/100 g
- Mixed salad greens with dressing: about 30 kcal/100 g

Energy estimate: pizza 75 g x 2.7 = 203 kcal; meat 100 g x 2.0 = 200 kcal; broccoli 135 g x 0.35 = 47 kcal; salad 38 g x 0.3 = 11 kcal. Total about 460 kcal.
